card.name: Leading digit 1 or 2 in numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (sometimes 2) that begins a new number, right before the next digit, in dosing tables and section numbers. It fires when the number follows a weight band, a table cell or a list item.

modes.label: Dose table numbers
modes.description: A leading 1 starts a dose or volume value in a weight-band table.
modes.example: 35 kg to less than 50 kg <<1>>0,000 mg twice daily

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A leading 1 or 2 starts a section heading number such as 10 or 2.4.
modes.example: <<2>>.4 Preparation of Oral Suspension Using Tablets

modes.label: Other table values
modes.description: A leading 1 starts a percentage or lab-value cell.

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a multi-digit number in dosing tables and section headings.
